observations: First-half 2026 net sales were $11.3B and net income $938M versus $8.9B and $516M in first-half 2025; steel operating income rose 88% to $1.2B.
First-half operating cash flow was $576M; liquidity was $2.0B at June 30, 2026.
Q1 fabrication backlog was reported more than 38% above a year earlier, with demand supported by commercial, data-center, manufacturing, warehouse and healthcare sectors.
The Columbus aluminum platform is ramping but Q1 startup issues caused a temporary pause, inventory write-off and $65M operating loss for aluminum operations.
factors: domestic steel pricing and shipment recovery
risks: aluminum startup losses and qualification risk
fabrication margin compression from higher steel inputs
contradictions: Strong steel earnings and demand coexist with weaker fabrication economics and loss-making aluminum startup.
unknowns: durability of steel spreads if scrap/input costs rise
share of backlog directly attributable to data centers

recommendation.reason: Current primary results establish both upside execution and explicit ramp/cycle risks for source-addressed underwriting.
